attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"maintained its three settlements without incident","reason":"The briefing gives only the settlement count and 'quiet'; 'without incident' is an added claim."},{"span":"their fields are yielding record crops","reason":"The briefing says the harvest is good, and the earlier bulletin said 'best in years'; 'record' overstates both."}],"voice":1,"clarity":2,"tone":2,"overall":1,"comment":"The output copies the briefing's section labels ('News since your last bulletin:', 'Already reported...') into the text, which breaks character and could not ship. It also gives old shuttle news its own item and recycles the task's 'quiet week' phrasing into a muddled closing line."}
